body:
## Why

In the chat view, the second plan download from one page didn't save in Chrome. Seen in the browser check for #170 (PR #172), on the local site. "Download plan" saved a file. Then "Download full plan" sent its request, which returned 200, but no file was saved. Reloading the page didn't help. A new tab saved it at once.

This is most likely Chrome's limit on a page starting more than one download. Chrome then asks in the address bar whether the site may download several files, and holds the download until the user allows it. The page starts each download itself, with a link it clicks after the fetch (`downloadFile()` in `web/src/api-client.ts`), so Chrome may count it as a download the page started, not the user. The two JSON downloads before #170 worked the same way, so this isn't new.

In the check, the first two downloads were started from a script, not a real click, which may be what set the limit off. So it isn't known yet whether a user who clicks both buttons hits it.

## Open questions

- Does a user who clicks "Download plan" and then "Download full plan" get both files, or a prompt? Check by hand in Chrome, with real clicks.
- If they get a prompt, is that fine as it is, since the user can allow it once for the site?

## Do

- Check the open questions in Chrome. If a fix is wanted, settle it here first.

## Done when

- The open questions are answered here.

## Ends in

A decision, or a PR if a fix is wanted.

**Settled in:** chat.
